text.KJV NEH 12:35: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

A.name: Judah
A.line: among the Levites who came up with Zerubabbel (NEH 12:8)
family: descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Judah
B.line: A priest in Nehemiah's time named among leaders in the dedication procession

why: יְהוּדָה appears in the procession’s list alongside Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah (Nehemiah 12:33–35), matching B’s stated role at the dedication. The passage gives no connection to A, the Levite who returned with Zerubbabel.
